GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly & bumped @ start . Pushed fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (1.5L from lead) early . Back 1/2L midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide @ 500m. Chasing 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Outsprinted 3 Wide in straight. # didn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and was the ntightened for room and lsot ground before being ridden along to obtain the position outside the lead.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok but copped bump, led rails 1000m, slipped away straightening and gave good sight, only claimed final stride and had to settle for close minor placing # led/held placing

Began OK. Rolled fwd & raced 5th 3 Wide No Cover (3.5L from lead) early . Stayed same until improving slowly @ 550m. Pushed along Four Wide @ 400m & pressured Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Struggled Six Wide in last 200m. # Wide & faded.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Rolled fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide until worked to =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pressured & briefly hit lead Six Wide @ 300m. Headed @ 250m & weakened in last 200m. # On-pace/weakened.
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide 2 lengths. joined leaders turn 3 wide. ran on well. 3 Wide trip # strong win
Jumped Ok to lead 1 length 1400m 1 length lead 800m .5l lead home turn Under Pressure Straightened Up leader weakened final 200m # led/one paced

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Pushed fwd & shared lead Two Wide early . Back 2 Lengths & tracked leader on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & carried out Four Wide @ 300m. Challenged leaders @ 150m & just faded a touch late. # Every Chance
Jumped Ok bustled to lead half clear, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear and kept going strong to the line # led/no danger
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 lengths. moved up 3 Wide 700 metres joining leader. battled away in Straight # went early

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. went to front turn.. battled away # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. moved up Wide turn 3 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
Jumped Ok went to front. back to 2nd 1000 metres. moved up 3 Wide turn 1 length. weakened # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rider said that her mount sweated up prior to the race and then pulled hard in the early and middle stages. She added thereafter her mount proved disappointing when plain in the straight until weakening late. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.
